_comment: Ratchet baseline for check_no_app_names.py. These counts may only go DOWN. The target for all four is zero: content reaches it at extraction (stage 7), imports at the AppSpec seams (stage 4), home_path_sites when every path in $HOME comes from config. `watched` is sticky on purpose, so an app that leaves the catalog is still scanned for leftovers. NOTE 2026-08-27: content/imports/literals were re-pinned at a HIGHER measured value on this date, once, because the scan area was widened from six directories to the tracked tree and an app-content file stopped short-circuiting out of all four checks. Nobody added those lines; the gate could not previously see them. See `raised` below for the full reason, which prints on every run until each count comes back down.
_content_files_note: content_files is DELIBERATELY LEFT AT 106 while the tree measures 120. De-hardcoding the two app registries (2026-09-01/02) moved app declarations out of platform files and into app-owned ones: 8 backend services/<app>_app.py and 7 frontend pages/apps/<app>/module.tsx. That is the upward move check_no_app_names.py's header calls legitimate -- it bought import_sites 24->17 and literal_sites 479->354, both pinned down here -- but check_ratchets_not_loosened.py is right that a worker does not re-pin upward to pass its own gate. So the gate reports the rise honestly and the pin is the operator's to make. The real fix is not a pin at all: it is EXTRACTION, which takes this count to zero and needs the repo decision in app-is-the-entity-2026-08-20.md section 10.
